header.title: Allocation Recipients
header.subtitle: Browse the complete history of allocation recipients, cycle statistics, and allocation distributions across all finalized Performance Cycles.
header.scopeTooltip: Totals cover finalized Performance Cycles. Active cycles and separate allocation retrieval records are excluded.

recipients.intro: When a Performance Cycle finalizes, the participant who made the Final Gesture retrieves the Signature Allocation — {percentage}% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and a unique Cosmic Signature NFT. Additional allocations flow through Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection, Anchor Distributions, Public Goods, and the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

reserveSplit.label: Cycle reserve split
reserveSplit.tooltip: Percentages show how a finalized cycle's ETH reserve is allocated across protocol tracks.

invalid.title: Invalid cycle number
invalid.help: The cycle number must be a positive integer.

error.title: Couldn't load this cycle
error.message: Cycle #{cycle} data failed to load. Try again, or go back to the recipients list.

recipientSection.title: Cycle recipients
recipientSection.description: Each role received a Cosmic Signature NFT when the cycle was finalized.
recipientSection.rolesInfo: Signature Allocation: the participant who made the Final Gesture. Chrono-Warrior: held the Endurance Champion position for the longest consecutive interval. Endurance Champion: stayed the most recent Gesture maker for the longest consecutive interval. Final CST Gesture: made the cycle's last Gesture with CST.

distribution.title: Allocation distribution
distribution.tooltip: Each track's share of the Cycle Reserve when this cycle was finalized, the same split the Allocation Recipients page shows. What was not allocated carries into the next cycle.

statistics.title: Cycle statistics
statistics.tooltip: Key metrics summarizing this cycle's activity and allocation distribution.

signatureEth.label: Signature Allocation
signatureEth.tooltip: The ETH portion of the Signature Allocation retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture of this cycle.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.tooltip: Wallets that received at least one allocation this cycle, each counted once.

uniqueAnchorHolders.label: Unique anchor-holders
uniqueAnchorHolders.tooltip: How many unique addresses had NFTs anchored during this cycle.

totalContributed.label: Contributed ETH
totalContributed.tooltip: Direct ETH contributions from the community during this cycle.

ledger.title: All allocations for this cycle
ledger.description: Every allocation record of the cycle, grouped by recipient.

empty.gestures: No gestures were made in this cycle.
empty.endurance: No Endurance Champion data available for this cycle.
empty.stellar: No Stellar Selection recipients for this cycle.
empty.anchoring: No Anchor Distributions in this cycle.
empty.nfts: No NFTs were attached to gestures in this cycle.
empty.erc20: No ERC-20 tokens were attached to gestures in this cycle.

contributions.nftsTooltip: NFTs attached to gestures during this cycle, forwarded to the participant who made the Final Gesture.
contributions.erc20Tooltip: ERC-20 tokens attached to gestures by participants, forwarded to the Signature Allocation recipient.

open.title: Cycle #{cycle} is still open
open.body: Its allocation record appears here once the cycle is finalized.

notStarted.title: Cycle #{cycle} hasn't started
notStarted.body: Cycles run one at a time, and Cycle #{live} is the one open now.

unknown.title: No record of Cycle #{cycle} yet
unknown.body: The cycle may still be open, or its record is still being indexed.

finalized.title: Allocation finalized

index.title: Latest finalized cycles
index.description: Each cycle's Signature Allocation, shown by the Signature it imprinted.
index.error: The latest cycles couldn't be loaded

empty.title: No cycle is finalized yet
empty.description: The first cycle's Signature Allocation appears here once it is finalized.

pending.successBody: Your finalization is on-chain. Its record appears here as soon as it is indexed; this page updates by itself.

result.title: Cycle #{cycle} Signature Allocation
result.successTitle: Congratulations! The Cycle #{cycle} Signature Allocation is yours
result.lede: What the participant who made the Final Gesture received when the cycle was finalized.
result.successLede: You made the Final Gesture of Cycle #{cycle}. The ETH, the CST and this Signature are now in your wallet.

finalized.nextCycle: The next cycle is open. <link>Go to the Observatory</link>

next.title: Next steps
next.body: There could also be additional allocations from Stellar Selection. To view your allocations, go to the <allocations>My Allocations</allocations> page. For Anchor Distributions, visit the <anchors>My Anchors</anchors> page.
